definitions.gloss: meat sauce; Bolognese-style tomato and ground meat sauce
definitions.explanation: A tomato-based sauce made with ground meat and onions, served mainly over spaghetti. In Japan it is one of the standard pasta sauces, sold ready-made in cans and retort pouches.

examples.japanese: ミートソースを{作|つく}る。
{今日|きょう}の{昼|ひる}ごはんはミートソースだ。
examples.english: Today's lunch is spaghetti with meat sauce.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもはミートソースのスパゲッティが{大好|だいす}きだ。
examples.english: Children love spaghetti with meat sauce.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}がない{時|とき}は、{市販|しはん}のミートソースを{温|あたた}めるだけでいい。
examples.english: When you have no time, you can just heat up store-bought meat sauce.

notes:
From English "meat sauce." In everyday Japanese it usually means the whole dish (spaghetti served with the sauce), not just the sauce itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミートソースのスパゲッティ: spaghetti with meat sauce
- ミートソースを{煮込|にこ}む: to simmer meat sauce
- {手作|てづく}りのミートソース: homemade meat sauce
- ミートソース{缶|かん}: canned meat sauce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ボロネーゼ: Bolognese — the Italian name, used for restaurant-style versions
- ナポリタン: Japanese-style ketchup spaghetti — sweeter, made with ketchup rather than a simmered tomato sauce
